name: MedMCQA
intro: MedMCQA是一个大规模多项选择题问答数据集，针对真实医学入学考试题目设计。包含来自AIIMS和NEET PG考试的19.4万道高质量题目，涵盖2400个医疗主题和21个医学科目。该数据集测试模型在广泛医学领域的推理能力。
build_method: 医学考试题收集, 纯文本质量清洗, 按考试防泄漏划分
build_method_en: Medical-exam collection, text-only quality cleaning, exam-based leakage-safe splitting
intro_en: MedMCQA is a large-scale multiple-choice question answering dataset designed for real medical entrance exam questions. It contains 194,000 high-quality questions from AIIMS and NEET PG exams, covering 2,400 medical topics and 21 medical subjects. This dataset evaluates models' reasoning abilities across a wide range of medical fields.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2203.14371 Sections 2-5. MedMCQA collects mock and online test-series questions plus official AIIMS PG and NEET PG exams from 1991 onward. It removes records without exactly four valid text options, image/table/external-context dependencies, curated keyword hazards, malformed HTML and symbols, missing fields, and duplicates; grammar suggestions receive human supervision. The exam-based split uses mock/online questions for train, NEET PG for development, and AIIMS PG for test, then removes dev/test items with pairwise Levenshtein similarity above 0.9. The released 193,155 questions span 21 subjects and about 2,400 topics: 182,822 train, 4,183 dev, and 6,150 test; evaluation reports overall and subject-wise accuracy.
